blocks.x: Retail media incrementality proven — clean-room measurement adopted by every major brand
A national consumer-electronics chain — Retail & Consumer Goods engagement delivered by a 15-person team over 12 months, North America scope, commercial model: build-run.

items: Vendor claims rested on last-touch logic; the retailer could not arbitrate.
Peak-season cloud costs discovered on invoices; P95 cost per order unknown.

blocks.x: We built the clean-room measurement service (joint retailer-brand testing without data leakage), engineered peak readiness with load/chaos discipline and unit-cost telemetry, and shipped privacy-architected personalization — consent-scoped profiling with clean-room verification. Brands now buy measured incrementality, not impressions.
The engagement was structured for transfer: named pod, documented runbooks, operator enablement, and a Compound phase that keeps challenger programs and conformance monitoring running after handover.

items: Energy per site down 18% — telemetry-driven optimization at 12,000 sites
Outcome evidence published — renewals secured with learning-gain pipelines

blocks.x: Towers: Data, Analytics & Lakehouse, Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering, Applied AI & Generative AI. Platforms: Achala Forge, Achala Nexus.

items: the decision/data architecture pattern, the control matrix and the run model — adapted per estate in weeks, not quarters.
organizational absorption: adoption paths are designed for each client's operating culture, never assumed.

blocks.x: Client identity withheld under confidentiality. Metrics are reported against the baseline locked in the Diagnose phase; measurement method available under NDA.
Ask for a reference conversation on this pattern — or map it to your estate in a briefing.
